title: Alisakrisa
requirements: Development of a high-fidelity female humanoid character model optimized for automated actor replacement in video footage. The asset needed to match photographic portrait references, sport contemporary athletic apparel, feature natural hair weights, and support dynamic cosmetic shaders. The final package had to comply with critical file structure manifests for cloud AI processing engines.
achievements: Configured highly precise PBR skin shaders with advanced cosmetic gradient maps
Engineered skeletal geometry matching strict bone naming and tracking constraints for cloud AI engines
Packaged files to ensure flawless motion and tracking in live scene replacements
